# Code style

* Use TypeScript
* Use 2 spaces for indentation
* Use double quotes for strings
* Use semicolons at the end of statements
* Prefer nullish coalescing (`??`) over logical OR (`||`) for default values
* Add TSDoc comments for functions with an `@author GitHub Copilot` tag to indicate that the code was generated by Copilot

# Project conventions

* When traversing the tree-sitter AST, prefer using `tree.walk()` over `tree.rootNode.descendantsOfType()`
